version-spec.create: @echo off set TAG={$$$ version $$$} git rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/%TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin %TAG% >NUL 2>&1 && goto :exists git tag %TAG% git push origin main --tags exit /b 0 :exists echo ERROR: tag %TAG% already exists - run -vinc first exit /b 1

meta.description: A quevu panel served over a local connection for Go: named pipes on Windows, Unix domain sockets elsewhere, and a JSON-lines protocol on top, so a controller in another process gets a quevu.Controller. Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/quevu-wire (package qwire) or its wire protocol.
